name: prims_ts_decode_wrapper_tuple_encoded_page4_multi_q_causal_plan_seq_lens_sq4_maxq4_maxk2048_wl-1_pf1_um1_h32_kv4_d128_sps4_ps32
description: Reusable PrimTS GQA decode wrapper. The plan fixes mask, window, static bounds, and exact batch size. The plan also owns the K/V length vector, so run() must omit seq_lens. Every run supplies a fixed row-strided page table; packed-Q runs also supply Q offsets.

causal.description: One for a causal plan and zero for a dense plan.

planned_full_kv_prefix.description: Whether plan() compiled the full-prefix specialization.

planned_uniform_max_kv_lengths.description: Whether plan() compiled uniform maximum K/V lengths.

plan_owns_seq_lens.description: One when plan() owns the K/V length vector and zero when run() supplies it.

page_size.description: Semantic size addressed by encoded subpage locators.

block_tables.description: Required fixed row-strided physical page table supplied to run().

seq_lens.description: Plan-owned per-request K/V lengths; this is optional trace context and run() must receive seq_lens=None.

qo_indptr.description: Cumulative Q offsets required by a packed-Q run.

validate.description: Whether to validate per-run tensors and metadata values.

check:
def standard_check(
    reference_outputs: Any,
    actual_outputs: Any,
    *,
    rtol: Optional[float] = None,
    atol: Optional[float] = None,
    max_mismatch_pct: float = 0.0,
    min_cos_sim: Optional[float] = 1.0 - 1e-3,
) -> bool:
    """Default trace correctness check used when a template does not override it."""
    from flashinfer.trace import default_check

    return default_check(
        reference_outputs,
        actual_outputs,
        rtol=rtol,
        atol=atol,
        max_mismatch_pct=max_mismatch_pct,
        min_cos_sim=min_cos_sim,
    )
